ValidationRule.description: Ensures that an agent can't update 'Have All Defects Been Rectified' from 'Yes' to either 'Customer Has Failed to Respond' or 'Referred for Exit' if the Case is not Closed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = "KYC_QA", NOT ( ISPICKVAL ( Status, "Closed" ) ), ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE ( Fraud_Defects_Rectified__c ), 'Yes'), OR ( ISPICKVAL ( Fraud_Defects_Rectified__c, 'Customer Has Failed to Respond' ), ISPICKVAL ( Fraud_Defects_Rectified__c, 'Referred for Exit') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: KYC checks are completed and defects are resolved, please update the case status to 'Under Review' and then to 'Rectify Defect/Pending Documents/Refer to Fraud' in-order to update the 'Have All Defects Been Rectified'
